content.short: Revest Finance provides instant liquidity for locked, vesting, and staked assets via Financial NFT smart vaults.
content.description: Revest Finance operates as an NFT lending DAO on the Ethereum network. The protocol enables the packaging, transfer, and storage of fungible ERC-20 tokens as non-fungible tokenized financial instruments that can be bought, sold, and held as discrete assets. Through these NFT instruments, users can trade ownership of underlying assets without altering their value, creating a novel meta-layer of commerce that expands how digital assets are valued, exchanged, and leveraged.
